description: This file implements utility functions for handling SPDY/HTTP2 headers in the QUIC protocol, including extracting content length, validating headers and trailers, populating headers from URLs, and extracting QUIC versions from Alt-Svc entries.

methods.name: ExtractContentLengthFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and validates the Content-Length header from HTTP headers.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from a list to a header block and validates them, including content length.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateTrailers
methods.description: Copies and validates trailer headers, including optional final byte offset.

methods.name: PopulateHeaderBlockFromUrl
methods.description: Populates HTTP/2 header block from a URL string.

methods.name: ExtractQuicVersionFromAltSvcEntry
methods.description: Extracts the QUIC version corresponding to an Alt-Svc entry based on supported versions.
